label: Tax Enforcement

notes.note: overlay checked; gauge concentric with lens, tilt kept, open-ended handle as drawn
both handle sides now run onto the ring's outer edge (120.27, 84.71) and (111.5, 92.87), merging as on the black sheet
Review fix verified by the independent reviewer (creative director)

corrections.what: Drew the lens as a true circle, centre (94.6, 65.92), r 29.06, and made the red gauge arc concentric with it, r 17.74
corrections.why: DR-03 true circles. The lens fits with rms 0.07 px. The gauge arc fits r 17.7 to 17.78 about a centre 0.8 px lower than the lens's; it moves up 0.8 px to share the lens centre.

corrections.what: Kept the gauge as a half-circle tilted as drawn, from 170.7 deg (left end, below the centre line) to -9.6 deg (right end, above it)
corrections.why: Feature as drawn. Both ends turn the same way by about 9.5 deg, so the arc reads as a rotated semicircle rather than a raster wobble; levelling it would move the ends about 3 px.

corrections.what: Drew the handle as a straight outline on a 44.2 deg axis: parallel sides 11.95 px apart, a round far end, and a near end open toward the lens with both sides running onto the ring's outer edge
corrections.why: DR-03 straight lines and review fix (must). The sides measure 11.95 px apart with slopes under 0.013. The black sheet shows both sides merged with the ring; the first trace left a 2.3 px gap on the upper side and only a tangent touch on the lower. The ends now sit on the ring's outer edge: upper start (120.27, 84.71), lower end (111.5, 92.87).

corrections.what: Spaced the four rules evenly, 17.41 px apart from y 27.22 to 79.45, from one left end at x 27.75
corrections.why: DR-03 equal repeats. Gaps measure 17.22, 17.27 and 17.74 px. Each rule keeps its own right end.

corrections.what: Gave the record's three full corners one radius, 4.2 px
corrections.why: DR-03. Diagonal profiles give 4.0 to 4.5 px. The lower-right corner turns up into a 3.3 px stub, as drawn.

corrections.what: Drew every stroke at the set weight W, 5.5 px
corrections.why: DR-03 one line weight. Strokes measure 5.25 to 5.5 px; the ink area ratio is about 1.03.

source_notes: Kept: the record as an open contour behind the magnifier (its right edge stops at y 26.3 above the lens and turns up only a short stub at the lower right), four rules of different lengths, the empty lens apart from the gauge arc, and the handle running down-right and merging into the ring on both sides. Red is only the inner gauge arc; this keeps it distinct from Donor Disclosure (red handle) and Watchdog Remedies (red check). Both sheets agree.
